title: Miami Deco Studies
description: Nine independent 80s Miami-deco poster studies — each is a resort-era announcement crop testing flamingo pink, tropical teal, mustard gold, palm silhouettes, and speedline triangles at modern print fidelity.
creative_direction: Each image is a 1:1 poster crop for a different resort-era announcement (palm poster, speedline announcement, standalone flamingo, mustard swoosh cover, pool deck, convertible dusk, boardwalk sign, cocktail kiosk, tennis club). Shared palette: flamingo pink plus tropical teal plus mustard gold. Shared treatments: angular speedline triangles, pastel stucco texture, condensed sans titles with curved underline swoosh.
